import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation, PillowWriter
from IPython.display import Image, display
from pathlib import Path

fs = 200  # 采样率：每秒 100 个样本
t = np.linspace(0, 2, fs, endpoint=False)  # 生成 0 到 1 秒的均匀时间点
f = 3  # 频率 f 控制每秒的周期数

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
line, = ax.plot([], [], linewidth=2)
samples, = ax.plot([], [], "o", markersize=4)
ax.set(xlim=(0, 2), ylim=(-1.4, 1.4))
ax.set_xlabel("Time (s)")
ax.set_ylabel("Amplitude")

def update(frame):
    phase = 4 * np.pi * frame / 60
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + phase)
    line.set_data(t, y)
    sample_t = t[::10]
    samples.set_data(sample_t, y[::10])
    ax.set_title(f"Sine wave and its samples (frame {frame})")
    return line, samples

anim = FuncAnimation(
    fig, update, frames=60, interval=50, blit=True
)

out = Path("dsp_demo.gif")
anim.save(out, writer=PillowWriter(fps=20))
plt.close(fig)
display(Image(filename=str(out)))
